Proponents of animal experimentation argue that the benefits to human health and safety far outweigh the costs, while opponents argue that certain animal testing procedures are cruel, unnecessary, and lack any scientific validity. This essay will argue that animal experimentation is both ethical and necessary for the advancement of medical research.
